title: chore(website): move routing to TanStack Router
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Step 2 of moving pollinations.ai to the website v2 (#14472): switch the old site from React Router to TanStack Router, matching v2's setup, so v2 pages can move over later with few changes.

- Adds one TanStack file route per page. `main.tsx` and the vite plugin/chunk config match v2, and `routeTree.gen.ts` is byte-identical to v2's.
- `/docs` redirects to `gen.pollinations.ai/docs` in the Worker, copied from v2. It used to go to `/play`.
- Removes the class-based `ErrorBoundary`. Page errors now show the router's default error screen, as on v2.
- Apps and Play read `?filter/sort/query` and `?model` through validated route search params.

**Verification** (main and this branch side by side, same data, 1440px and 390px)
- Every element on all 7 pages matches in position, size and colour.
- Same behaviour for: nav links and active state, scroll reset, back button, Apps search URL updates in place, `?model=` preselect, unknown path → `/`, footer links, `#api_key` cleanup.
- One URL difference: a numeric-looking search value is quoted in the URL (`?query=%22123%22`); the page reads it the same.
- Bundle: vendor JS 77 → 97 kB gzip (router).
- Remaining site diff to v2: 220 → 216 files, +13,432 → +12,878 lines.

gist.headline: New paths through the garden
gist.blurb: The website gets TanStack Router under the hood, lining up its paths with website v2. The pages look the same; the route to the docs gets shorter.
gist.summary: The website replaces React Router with TanStack file routes matching website v2, redirects /docs to gen.pollinations.ai/docs instead of /play, and validates Apps and Play search parameters.
gist.impact: The seven pages keep their existing layout and navigation behavior, while /docs leads directly to the API docs and Apps and Play retain URL-based search and model selection.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the routing change as a friendly garden junction with signs for Apps, Play, and Docs; the Docs path leads to a small glowing API manual. Polli tends the paths while a CRT monitor robot holds a tidy route map, suggesting a careful under-the-hood change rather than a visual redesign.
